name: Cause Headache
body:
School: necromancy; Level antipaladin 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: V

EFFECT

Range: touch

s

Target: one living creature touched
Duration: instantaneous
Saving Throw: Fort negates; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The targeted creature instantly develops a throbbing headache, becoming sickened. The headache lasts for 2d3 hours or until the target is the subject of a cure spell or remove disease. Delay pain affects a headache normally.
